hypothesis: A fixed action-class reweighting of actual scripted factual calibration demonstrations improves rare calibration recall and real closed-loop reward relative to unweighted behavior cloning and matched reward-only policy gradient. This is a learnability mechanism test only, not new native causal-rule discovery.
null: If calibrated action recall or actual selected closed-loop reward does not beat matched controls under precommitted thresholds, record diagnostic no-go; no editing thresholds after scoring.

source.worlds: Independent hidden causal sign ±1 balanced across stable/switch worlds, fresh B starts 9..18 and return 22..35, identical original R70 persistent physical calibration law. All learner inputs only public timestep and actual selected action+observed consequence.
source.reference: Nonprivileged original public-time R70 calibrate t0,16,32, selected factual observations only; three rare calibration events and 37 other events per world (7.5% calibration positives), no private oracle labels.
source.source_custody: Never access R72 scored HOLDOUT, R72 FIT, R71 scored source, or protected external OOD. All model training and weight freeze before generating R73 HOLDOUT.

training.world_selection_seed_formula: 24519999 + seed across ALL models, objective arms and architectures; same FIT world draws
training.initialization: R71 fresh original model initialization for same architecture and seed (never saved R71/R72 weights); same init across four objectives.
training.BC_loss: Teacher-forced actual selected public R70 fixed-policy action/outcome history; cross entropy per step.
training.class_weight_reduction: Sum of weighted per-observation cross-entropy over each 40-step factual episode divided by sum of fixed weights of those target actions. No dynamic class weights, CAL/DEV tuning or sample selection.
training.negative: Circularly shift teacher action targets +5 steps within each episode while preserving factual teacher histories and marginal action frequencies; same fixed class weights as candidate.
training.reward_only: R72 original REINFORCE selected real actual reward-to-go, with same optimizer, steps, source selected action budget and entropy 0.005, no teacher labels.

scoring.primary: Actual net selected episode reward on 64 fresh holdout worlds with greedy rollouts.
scoring.teacher_agreement: Teacher-forced selected factual actions: separate calibration recall, false positive rate among 37 noncalibration steps, precision and F1; do not substitute overall agreement.
scoring.controls: Matched unweighted BC, shifted-target weighted negative, selected-return REINFORCE for each architecture, original fixed public-time R70 CALIBRATE_CAUSAL, original no-calibrate reward-reactive.
scoring.on_pass: DEV_RARE_SCRIPTED_ACTION_LEARNABILITY_SIGNAL_ONLY, NOT native intelligence, original task independent scientific pass, unfamiliar transfer or new causal-law invention.
scoring.on_fail: DEV_DIAGNOSTIC_NO_GO; preserve original HOLDOUT and do not retune loss weights, selection schedules or thresholds post-score.
